text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to watch the dance lesson, but... 
Mihono Bourbon is staring intently into 
the mirror for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Processing information. All clear. Deemed 
acceptable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing situation from persons, 
location, and various data. Detecting 
possibilities...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Result: Deemed "scary-looking."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, you are here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my face. Just now, while walking 
through the shopping district, I locked 
eyes with a baby and made them cry.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Judging from the situation, I have reached 
the conclusion that "your face is scary."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? I cannot detect any other 
possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem hurt by being cried at, 
but she does appear to be concerned about 
it...
choice_data_list: Maybe they were just in a bad mood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see... I hadn't taken the other person's 
mood into account.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Mihono Bourbon touched her own 
cheek and looked into the mirror once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: They cried on me again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell babies apart, but based on 
the parents' faces, it is the same person.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I confirmed that until she saw me, her 
status was "Happy," and she was smiling.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I must conclude that the issue lies with 
me after all."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bourbon-san! ...And Bourbon-san's 
Trainer, hello!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower-san. Yes, good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... did something happen? You have a 
troubled look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained everything that had happened 
so far to Nishino Flower, who looked 
deeply concerned.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—In short, the problem lies with me. That 
is the conclusion I have reached.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bourbon-san, what did you think when 
you saw the baby?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Body is small, lacks power. All actions 
are restricted. Assessed as 'weak' in 
every aspect.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Meaning they just make you 
want to protect them!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Her body looks soft and lacking in 
endurance. Those big eyes staring intently 
this way are always moist—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. So you mean it's cute!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Yes, putting it simply, that 
might be the case.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't it be great to turn those 
feelings into smiles?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A smile...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Babies watch you so closely, they end up 
mirroring your facial expressions!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"A baby in my neighborhood reacted that 
way, so I'm sure it'll make this little 
one smile too!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. In other words, you're trying to 
copy the facial expression.
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's show them our smiling 
faces!
Let's try making all kinds of faces!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Request accepted. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Updating information based on acquired 
data. Will verify during the next 
execution.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, Flower-san. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I hope it goes well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while shopping in the district, 
Mihono Bourbon came running over from up 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I have put Operation... 'Don't Make 
the Baby Cry' into action.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That's what this report is about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Result: Success. Infant's 'Smile' 
acquired.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. A baby's smile is, well...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It was very... cute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She probably didn't realize it herself. 
Yet Mihono Bourbon smiled, wearing the 
very same gentle expression she had shown 
the baby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. So we are to test and analyze 
every possible pattern, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Updating information based on acquired 
data. Will verify during the next 
execution.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fufu, do your best, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while shopping in the district, I 
spotted Mihono Bourbon with a couple who 
had a baby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to call out to her, 
Mihono Bourbon noticed me—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, your timing is excellent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Operation... "Make Various Facial 
Expressions" has been initiated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will now report the results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Anger’ and ‘Sadness’ could not be 
executed. Testing was conducted solely on 
‘Smiles’."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not understand. However, when my 
"smile" was met with another "smile," I 
detected a warmth in the vicinity of my 
chest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, it became difficult for 
me to make any other facial expressions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cause unknown. Facial expression locked 
into a smile. It is assumed an error has 
occurred either in the facial muscles or 
in the chest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...It's a mystery. It requires 
investigation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon was pondering deeply with a 
puzzled look on her face. Though it was 
obvious enough that practically anyone 
could have noticed without needing an 
explanation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘I just wanted to keep seeing that 
smile.’ ‘I couldn't help smiling back at 
the baby's smile.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to look forward to the day she 
would arrive at that answer.
